carryover.basis: each consecutive pair of seasons is regressed team-on-team and the mean of the most recent pairs is the league slope. When last season stops predicting this one, this number falls on its own — nobody edits a constant. It is the portal/NIL argument answered with arithmetic.

immutability: only the snapshot for the week the board currently stands at may be rewritten, because its games are still landing. Every earlier week is a finished record and the build refuses to touch it — a history you are allowed to edit is not a history.
reconstructed_basis: built after the fact with --through-week: every game after week ordinal 0 was put back to unplayed, but the TALENT half is read from the player artifact as it stands today, which did not exist in the week being reconstructed. It is a reconstruction of what this board would say about that week, not a record of what it did say, and it is labelled as one everywhere it appears.
